name: FlickBar
tagline: 保留 iPhone 原生键盘，加入底部快捷工具栏与字母下滑输入。
description: FlickBar 为 iPhone 系统键盘加入底部编辑快捷工具栏，提供撤销、重做、剪切、复制和粘贴。
在带提示的字母键上下滑，即可输入对应数字或符号；普通点击仍输入字母。候选栏独立显示，不增加键盘高度。
features: 底部小图标工具栏：撤销、重做、剪切、复制、粘贴
英文字母 QWERTY 与简体拼音全键盘下滑输入数字或符号
保留 iPhone 原生按键布局和完整候选栏
首次安装默认关闭，可分别控制工具栏和字母下滑
English、简体中文、繁體中文设置
compatibility: 底部工具栏需要地球键与麦克风之间的原生留白；部分 Home 键机型、横屏或其他布局可能隐藏工具栏
其他键盘布局保持原样；第三方输入法不保证支持
实机覆盖仍有限，iOS 16 尚未完成真机验证
usage: 安装后打开“设置”→ FlickBar，手动开启总开关。
按需开启底部编辑工具栏和字母键下滑输入。
下滑带提示的字母键，例如 q 下滑输入 1；普通点击仍输入字母。
选中文字后使用剪切、复制；撤销跟随系统编辑分组，可能一次回退连续输入的一整段。
避免同时开启强制更改系统键盘布局的插件。
notice: 首次安装默认关闭，升级保留本版本系列中已明确开启的设置。截图中的玻璃和背景美化不属于 FlickBar 提供的功能。

changes: 新增底部撤销、重做、剪切、复制与粘贴快捷工具栏。
支持字母键下滑输入数字和符号，保留原生键盘布局与完整候选栏。
首次安装默认关闭，提供中英繁三语设置与独立功能开关。

en.name: FlickBar
en.tagline: Keep the native iPhone keyboard with a bottom editing toolbar and letter-key flicks.
description: FlickBar adds a compact bottom toolbar to the iPhone system keyboard with undo, redo, cut, copy, and paste.
Flick down on a hinted letter to enter its number or symbol. Normal taps still enter letters; the candidate row stays separate and the keyboard height is unchanged.
features: Compact bottom icons for undo, redo, cut, copy, and paste
Number and symbol flicks on English QWERTY and Simplified Chinese Pinyin letter keys
Native iPhone key layout and full-width candidate row
Disabled on first installation, with separate toolbar and flick controls
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese settings
compatibility: The toolbar requires native space between the globe and microphone; some Home-button devices, landscape modes, or other layouts may hide it
Other layouts remain unchanged; third-party keyboards are not guaranteed
Physical-device coverage remains limited; iOS 16 has not been validated on a physical device
usage: Open Settings → FlickBar after installation and enable the main switch.
Enable the editing toolbar and letter-key flicks as needed.
Flick down on a hinted letter, such as q for 1; normal taps still enter letters.
Select text before cutting or copying. Undo follows system editing groups and may revert a whole continuous typing session.
Avoid simultaneously enabling tweaks that force a different system keyboard layout.
en.notice: Disabled on first installation; explicitly enabled settings from this release series are preserved on upgrade. The glass and background styling in the screenshot are not supplied by FlickBar.

changes: Added a bottom editing toolbar with undo, redo, cut, copy, and paste.
Added letter-key number and symbol flicks while preserving the native layout and full-width candidate row.
Disabled on first installation, with separate feature controls and English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese settings.
